findings_resolved_same_run.finding: The public /tienda controller was AllowAnonymous but had no rate-limit metadata even though the N7.9 preflight explicitly identified anonymous abuse as a security risk and the application already exposed a fixed-window IP policy.
findings_resolved_same_run.root_cause: The existing AuthLogin fixed-window limiter was registered globally in Program.cs and UseRateLimiter was active, but TiendaController did not opt into any named policy.
findings_resolved_same_run.recovery: Apply the existing AuthLogin policy at TiendaController class level, preserving AllowAnonymous while bounding public storefront requests by remote IP; add a directed reflection test proving both anonymous access and rate-limit policy metadata.

public_store: Product/category responses remain filtered to active public DTOs.
Checkout input is bounded by line count, quantity and identity lengths.
Checkout recomputes product, exact physical variant, stock and price from server-side authorities and rejects ambiguous legacy variant identity.
Public controller now opts into an existing fixed-window IP rate limiter rather than adding a parallel limiter implementation.
payment_boundary: PagosOnlineController remains authenticated, tenant-scoped and permission-gated.
Payment initiation requires Idempotency-Key and PagoOnlineService hashes the key before persistence lookup.
Provider checkout URLs are restricted to absolute HTTPS.
Provider exceptions are persisted only as the safe code PROVIDER_INIT_FAILED and are not echoed raw.
No PAN/CVV or raw payment credentials are accepted by this stage.
platform_observability: Security headers, explicit CORS, JWT validation, health and readiness endpoints remain configured in Program.cs.
This stage introduces no secret, deployment or production configuration changes.

causal_gate.close_condition: Terminal SUCCESS on the exact functional candidate, including backend build/tests and the directed storefront security test.
